value.rationale: A complete full-dimensional Euclidean John ellipsoid for the canonical bipartite matching polytope is a motivated invariant; the given center, anisotropy, contact facets and volume are mathematically meaningful. Nevertheless the full statement is already a literal K_{n,n} specialization of the published vertex/edge-transitive fractional matching theorem (including its explicit K_{d,d} root and every facet contact). The remaining algebra is routine spectral decomposition of the incidence matrix and a coordinate conversion; it provides no independently unknown exact fact, boundary classification or non-implied new theorem. Useful as an illustrative derivation, but not an additional research finding.
